comment: Chains the Tauren saga owns: Camp Narache and Mulgore. Text only; every name, level and point comes from the facts.

chains.name: Camp Narache
chains.summary: Young tauren prove themselves at Camp Narache on Red Cloud Mesa, hunting for Grull Hawkwind, serving Chief Hawkwind and his mother, and fighting the Bristlebacks of Brambleblade Ravine.

quests.task: Bring 7 Plainstrider Feathers and 7 pieces of Plainstrider Meat to Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache.
Bring 10 Mountain Cougar Pelts to Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache.
Kill Battleboars and bring 8 Battleboar Snouts and 8 Battleboar Flanks to Grull Hawkwind.
Search for Greatmother Hawkwind near the water well southeast of Camp Narache.
Take a Water Pitcher from the water well, then return to Chief Hawkwind.
Travel to Seer Graytongue in the hills directly south of Camp Narache.
Carry the Smoldering Incense to the shrine of An'she and Mu'sha in the southeastern hills within ten minutes.
Kill Bristlebacks in Brambleblade Ravine and bring 12 Bristleback Belts to Chief Hawkwind.
Bring the Bristleback Attack Plans to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache.
Bring the head of Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle to Brave Windfeather in Red Cloud Mesa.
Bring the Bundle of Furs to Innkeeper Kauth in Bloodhoof Village.
Take the Totem of Hawkwind to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village, along the road out of Camp Narache.

chains.name: Rites of the Earthmother
chains.summary: The rites lead from Bloodhoof Village to Seer Wiserunner, to the Ancestral Spirit at Red Rocks, and to Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff, who asks for the Horn of Arra'chea.

quests.task: Speak with Zarlman Two-Moons in Bloodhoof Village.
Collect 2 Well Stones and 2 Ambercorn and bring them to Zarlman Two-Moons in Bloodhoof Village.
Consume the Water of the Seers in front of the tribal fire in Bloodhoof Village and follow the vision to Seer Wiserunner.
Travel to Red Rocks east of Thunder Bluff and speak with the Ancestral Spirit.
Speak with Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
Bring the Horn of Arra'chea to Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.

chains.name: The Water Wells of Mulgore
chains.summary: Mull Thunderhorn of Bloodhoof Village makes cleansing totems for the Winterhoof, Thunderhorn and Wildmane water wells, and sends his report to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

quests.task: Bring 6 Prairie Wolf Paws and 4 Plainstrider Talons to Mull Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village.
Use the Winterhoof Cleansing Totem at the Winterhoof Water Well, then return to Mull Thunderhorn.
Bring 6 Stalker Claws and 6 Cougar Claws to Mull Thunderhorn.
Use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem at the Thunderhorn Water Well, then return to Mull Thunderhorn.
Bring 8 Prairie Alpha Teeth to Mull Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village.
Use the Wildmane Cleansing Totem at the Wildmane Water Well, then return to Mull Thunderhorn.
Bring Thunderhorn's Report to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

chains.name: The Venture Co.
chains.summary: Morin Cloudstalker watches the Venture Co. from outside Bloodhoof Village, from the Ravaged Caravan to the Venture Co. Mine and Supervisor Fizsprocket.

quests.task: Examine the supply crate at the Ravaged Caravan for Morin Cloudstalker.
Return the Venture Co. Documents to Morin Cloudstalker near Bloodhoof Village.
Kill 14 Venture Co. Workers and 6 Venture Co. Supervisors for Morin Cloudstalker.
Kill Supervisor Fizsprocket and return his clipboard to Morin Cloudstalker.
Collect the rest of Supervisor Fizsprocket's pages inside The Venture Co. Mine and bring them to Morin Cloudstalker.
Bring the Clearcutter Key to Morin Cloudstalker outside Bloodhoof Village.

chains.name: Bloodhoof Village
chains.summary: Bloodhoof Village sets its tasks on the plains of Mulgore: the Palemane gnolls, the swoops, the Windfury harpies, the dwarven diggers, and the Bristleback Interlopers at Red Rocks.

quests.task: Bring 8 Trophy Swoop Quills to Harken Windtotem in Bloodhoof Village.
Defeat Chakuyak and bring her pelt to Yaw Sharpmane.
Feed Kyle the Frenzied, the puppy of Ahab Wheathoof at Bloodhoof Village.
Bring 8 Windfury Talons to Ruul Eagletalon in Bloodhoof Village.
Bring a Prairie Wolf Heart, Flatland Cougar Femur, Plainstrider Scale and Swoop Gizzard to Maur Raincaller at Bloodhoof Village.
Collect 5 Prospector's Picks, smash them at a forge, and bring 5 Broken Tools to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village.
Kill 10 Palemane Tanners, 8 Palemane Skinners and 5 Palemane Poachers, then return to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village.
Find someone who knows of Ghost Howl.
Kill 8 Bristleback Interlopers at Red Rocks for Lorekeeper Raintotem.

chains.name: The Galak Centaurs
chains.summary: Longwalker Malah Longwind sends a report from the edge of Mulgore to Bloodhoof Village. Baine Bloodhoof orders the Galak centaurs driven out, and the word goes to High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.

quests.task: Find Longwalker Malah Longwind east of Bloodhoof Village, near the edge of Mulgore.
Bring Longwalker Malah's Report to Brave Wildrunner in Bloodhoof Village.
Bring Longwalker Malah's Report to Baine Bloodhoof.
Kill 6 Galak Centaurs and 4 Galak Outrunners, and bring the head of Herak the Pillager to Baine Bloodhoof.
Seek audience with High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
Help Perith Stormhoof escape Palemane Rock, then report his safety to Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.

chains.name: Journey to the Crossroads
chains.summary: Kirge Sternhorn sends tauren on from the south of the Barrens to Thork at the Crossroads.

quests.task: Speak with Thork at the Crossroads in the Barrens.
